functions.name: submit_day_plan
functions.desc:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

json_schema.title: submit_day_plan

content.content:
Pick a few good restaurants with decent rating: Bar Gernika Basque Pub & Eatery (4.3), Houndstooth Grill & Tavern (4.4), Midnight Espresso (4.3), Boombox Cafe (3.6). For breakfast maybe "Midnight Espresso". Lunch "Bar Gernika". Dinner "Houndstooth Grill & Tavern".

Now plan days.

Day 1 (Mar 27): flight Denver->Palm Springs (choose flight). Choose flight F3880999 price 227, dep 11:16 arr 12:28. Use that. Arrival midday. Check in accommodation. Breakfast maybe before flight? Could have breakfast at home? We'll set breakfast "-". Lunch after arrival maybe at Bar Gernika. Afternoon attraction: Palm Springs Art Museum. Evening dinner at Houndstooth Grill.

Day 2 (Mar 28): Full day Palm Springs. Breakfast at Midnight Espresso. Morning attraction: Palm Springs Aerial Tramway. Lunch at Bar Gernika again. Afternoon attractions: Moorten Botanical Garden; Indian Canyons. Dinner at Houndstooth.

Day 3 (Mar 29): Morning breakfast at Midnight Espresso. Morning attraction: Palm Springs Air Museum. Lunch at Bar Gernika. Afternoon flight back to Denver (choose flight F3870938 price 241 dep 13:50 arr 16:50). After arrival. End.

Now compute budget: Flights total approx 227+241 = $468. Accommodation $860. Meals: assume breakfast $15, lunch $25, dinner $40 per day => per day $80, for 3 days $240. Attractions maybe entry fees but not accounted. Total approx $468+860+240 = $1568, under $2200.

Now need to submit day plans using submit_day_plan for each day. Include fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

For day 1: current_city maybe "Denver to Palm Springs". transportation string include flight details. Use flight number, departure, arrival. So "Flight Number: F3880999, from Denver to Palm Springs, Departure Time: 11:16, Arrival Time: 12:28". Breakfast "-". Attraction: "Palm Springs Art Museum, Palm Springs;". Lunch: "Bar Gernika Basque Pub & Eatery, Palm Springs". Dinner: "Houndstooth Grill & Tavern, Palm Springs". Accommodation: "Gorgeous 1BR brownstone in Harlem close to trains, Palm Springs". (Assume check-in). Also need city for day: "Palm Springs". current_city field maybe same.

Day 2: transportation "-" (no travel). Breakfast: "Midnight Espresso, Palm Springs". Attractions: "Palm Springs Aerial Tramway, Palm Springs; Moorten Botanical Garden, Palm Springs; Indian Canyons, Palm Springs;". Lunch: "Bar Gernika Basque Pub & Eatery, Palm Springs". Dinner: "Houndstooth Grill & Tavern, Palm Springs". Accommodation same.

Day 3: transportation flight back. "Flight Number: F3870938, from Palm Springs to Denver, Departure Time: 13:50, Arrival Time: 16:50". Breakfast: "Midnight Espresso, Palm Springs". Attractions: "Palm Springs Air Museum, Palm Springs;". Lunch: "Bar Gernika Basque Pub & Eatery, Palm Springs". Dinner: "-" (maybe flight). Accommodation "-". current_city maybe "Palm Springs to Denver". Use "Palm Springs".

Now call submit_day_plan three times.
